objective_value: <float> Total cost of the solution, combining supply costs across all customer-facility-period triples with inventory holding costs across all facilities and periods.
assignment: <dict, key: '{customer}'> Index of the single facility to which each customer is assigned for the entire planning horizon.
inventory: <dict, key: '{facility}', value: list[float] of length num_periods> Amount of product held at each facility at the end of each period.
